rationale: The agent located the user and viewed multiple orders, but then submitted a return without first confirming the item or the action with the user, violating the confirm-before-write policy. It also processed the refund to a gift card despite the user requesting a refund to a credit card, without attempting the preferred method or explaining why it wasn’t possible. The agent did not verify which of the two tablets was the more expensive one before proceeding. While the final message matches the tool action taken, the lack of confirmation and ignoring the specified refund preference cause the interaction to fail the policy-aligned completion bar.
